item.description: Mel Ydreos, Secretary General of the International Gas Union, says data centers have emerged as a new driver of global gas demand. He speaks with Yvonne Man and Minmin Low on "Bloomberg: The China Show." (Source: Bloomberg)

item.title: Review: María Corina Machado Returns to Venezuela
item.description: After nearly 10 months in exile, Ms. Machado, a Nobel laureate, came back to challenge leaders who have sidelined her and press for new elections.
